    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    event = intercept_targeted_spell_before_resolving(event_id)
    if counter_conditions_match(actor,event):
        cancel_or_drain_spell_once(event)
        apply_any_resource_conversion_specified_by_ability(actor,event)

    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
